pages.text: Tomorrow, Bix is going to go camping!
Bix puts water and sandwiches in a backpack.
By the lake, Bix puts up a small tent.
At night it is very dark, so Bix turns on a torch.
"Look at all the stars!" says Bix. "This is the best holiday ever!"

questions.ask: Where does Bix put the sandwiches?
What does Bix use in the dark?
